info.name: ShopEase API (local)
info.description: Postman collection for the local ShopEase training app. Run ONLY against http://127.0.0.1:5000 (or another authorised local instance). Run folders in order; folders 03-04 need an active alice session (run '01 Auth > Login as alice'). Postman keeps cookies automatically per domain. Collection NOT yet executed by the author - see docs/test-execution-report.md.

exec: // Unique username each run (max 20 chars: letters, digits, underscore)

pm.test('Response has id, username, email and no password', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.username).to.eql(pm.environment.get('newUsername')); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('password'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); });
pm.test('Error body has code and message', function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('message'); });
pm.test('Error body has code and message', function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('message'); });
pm.test('Field errors listed', function () { const f = pm.response.json().error.fields; pm.expect(f).to.have.all.keys('username','email','password'); });

item.name: GET me - not logged in (negative, run BEFORE login or after logout)

exec: pm.test('Profile has no password hash', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.username).to.eql('alice'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); });
pm.test('count matches products length', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.products.length).to.eql(j.count); });

pm.test('Each product has required fields and types', function () { pm.response.json().products.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(p.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.price).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.a('number'); }); });

pm.test('Only Wireless Mouse returned', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.products[0].name).to.eql('Wireless Mouse'); pm.expect(j.products[0].price).to.eql(19.99); });
pm.test('Error body has code and message', function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('message'); });
pm.test('Product 1 is Wireless Mouse at 19.99', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Wireless Mouse'); pm.expect(j.price).to.eql(19.99); });
pm.test('Error body has code and message', function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('message'); });

pm.test('Cart has items[] and numeric subtotal', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.subtotal).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.total_items).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Cart has items[] and numeric subtotal', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.subtotal).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.total_items).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: 04 Checkout and orders (needs login as alice)

exec: pm.test('Error body has code and message', function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('message'); });

pm.test('Order is PLACED with consistent totals', function () { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('PLACED'); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(Math.round((o.subtotal + o.shipping) * 100) / 100); pm.environment.set('lastOrderId', o.id); });
pm.test('Error body has code and message', function () { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(e).to.have.property('message'); });

pm.test('count matches and newest order first', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.orders.length).to.eql(j.count); pm.expect(j.orders[0].id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.environment.get('lastOrderId'))); });
